data.one_liner: Fade out particle effect for disappearing widgets like Text and Icon
data.what_it_does: Wrap a widget and animate it with fading particles when the disappear flag is true. The animation runs automatically and can trigger an optional callback when finished.
use_when: Need a quick visual fade-out effect for text or icons
Want a lightweight, cross-platform animation without heavy dependencies
Implementing a simple disappearing view in a UI
avoid_when: Complex custom particle effects or physics-based motion required
Need to animate non-textual widgets with custom shapes
Require fine-grained control over particle parameters
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single line of code
Works on all supported platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
weaknesses: Only supports fade-out, not other animation styles
No support for custom callbacks beyond onAnimationEnd
data.minimal_example:
FadeOutParticle(
  disappear: true,
  child: Text('Fade out Particle'),
)
